titre: La population quitte les très grands comtés
sous_titre: Migration intérieure nette, en milliers d'habitants, de juillet 2024 à juillet 2025

1 million et plus.texte: Collectively, the 50 counties with 1 million or more people in 2025 had a net domestic migration loss of 637,634.

50 000 à 999 999.texte: large counties (50,000-999,999 in population) had a combined net domestic migration gain of 533,766

15 000 à 49 999.texte: medium-sized counties (15,000-49,999) had a net domestic migration gain of 95,095

Moins de 15 000.texte: Even small counties (less than 15,000) had a slight net domestic migration gain of 8,773.
